notes:
### 1. Product Overview
Grain is an AI-powered meeting recording and note-taking platform that automatically captures, transcribes, and summarizes video calls across platforms like Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams, turning conversations into searchable, shareable insights.
* **Source URL:** `https://coldiq.com/tools/grain`
* **Verbatim Quote:** `"Grain is an AI-powered meeting tool designed for sales, customer success, and product teams. It automatically records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings to keep teams focused without manual note-taking."`

### 2. Authentication Methods & Multi-Tenant Integration
* **Available Auth Methods:** The public API supports Personal Access Tokens (PATs) passed as a Bearer token, and the platform also supports OAuth2 for specific pre-built integrations.
  * **Source URL:** `https://nango.dev/integrations/grain`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Grain offers both OAuth and API_KEY authentication modes. For the API_KEY auth mode, Authorization: Bearer apiKey is passed in the request header to access different endpoints, where apiKey is your account's personal access token."`
  * **Source URL:** `https://grain.com/app/settings/integrations?tab=api`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Every request needs a token in the Authorization header and a Public-Api-Version header (see Versions). ... curl -X GET \ -H "Authorization: Bearer grain_pat_example123" \ -H "Public-Api-Version: 2026-10-01" \ https://api.grain.com/_/public-api/v2/token-info"`
* **Primary Auth for Multi-Tenant Integration:** `bearer_token`
  * **Reasoning:** Because Grain's public developer documentation instructs users to generate individual Personal Access Tokens (PATs) for custom API access, a multi-tenant integration platform would have users provide their static PAT.
  * **Source URL:** `https://grain.com/app/settings/integrations?tab=api`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"A Personal Access Token (PAT) authenticates requests as you, with the same access you have in Grain. Generate one here: https://grain.com/app/settings/integrations?tab=api."`

### 3. Credential Acquisition & Cost
* **Access Level:** `self_serve_free`
* **How to get credentials:** Any developer can sign up for a free Grain account and instantly generate a Personal Access Token from the workspace settings without requiring manual approval or partner review.
  * **Source URL:** `https://grain.com/app/settings/integrations?tab=api`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"1. Create a Personal Access Token. A Personal Access Token (PAT) authenticates requests as you, with the same access you have in Grain. Generate one here: https://grain.com/app/settings/integrations?tab=api."`
* **Cost / Plan Requirements:** Grain offers a free tier, and the personal API is available across plans.
  * **Source URL:** `https://grain.com/release-note/06-18-2025`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"try grain today. it’s free forever."`
  * **Source URL:** `https://grain.com/release-note/06-18-2025` *(from the March 25, 2026 update section)*
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Personal API on Starter. We said we'd bring it to Starter. It's there now. Build on your Grain data from any plan."`

### 4. API Technical Details
* **API Style:** REST API
  * **Source URL:** `https://semarize.com/resources/get-your-data/grain`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Grain exposes recordings and transcripts through a REST API at api.grain.com/_/public-api/."`
* **Breadth:** Covers reading and managing recordings, highlights, video uploads, tags, action items, teams, users, and webhooks.
  * **Source URL:** `https://grain.com/app/settings/integrations?tab=api`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"The Grain API lets you read and manage recordings, highlights, uploads, and more."`
  * **Source URL:** `https://grain.com/release-note/06-18-2025` *(from the March 6, 2026 update section)*
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Two highly-requested additions for API users: tags and action items! Dig into the docs at developers.grain.com."`
* **OpenAPI Spec:** None found publicly.
  * **Source URL:** `https://apitracker.io/`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"OpenAPI/Swagger specs. -"`
* **Webhooks:** Supported. Event types include `recording_added`, `recording_updated`, and `recording_deleted`.
  * **Source URL:** `https://grain.com/app/settings/integrations?tab=api` *(from the Hooks section)*
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Hooks let Grain notify your server when something happens. Create one with a hook_type and a URL, and Grain sends a POST request to that URL whenever a matching event occurs."`
* **Sandbox:** None found.
  * **Source URL:** `https://apitracker.io/`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Sandbox environment. -"`

### 5. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers
* **MCP Status:** `official`
* **Details:** Grain hosts and maintains an official remote MCP server available to all users.
  * **Source URL:** `https://grain.com/release-note/06-18-2025`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"official grain mcp server announced: june 18, 2025 mike adams ‍ grain's official mcp server is available now for all users! 🎉"`
* **Configuration:**
  * **Source URL:** `https://grain.com/release-note/06-18-2025`
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"mangual config via mcp-remote : { "grain": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "https://api.grain.com/_/mcp"] } }"`

### 6. Buildability Verdict & Blockers
* **Verdict:** `ready_now`
* **Main Blocker:** None. The API documentation is fully public, and credentials can be obtained immediately via self-serve methods on a free account.
